0ab2439717.q: What outcomes movement does Finding Common Purpose promote for working Americans?
0ab2439717.a: Finding Common Purpose advocates for an outcomes movement that judges whether working Americans are thriving based on housing, mental health, savings, wages, healthcare, and community indicators. The foundation grants into communities to help them focus on measurable outcomes like housing and childcare and wages, setting baselines to allow people to debate policy solutions that can move these metrics.

37e48affff.q: What three pivotal moments shaped Andrew Wolk's career as a social entrepreneur and philanthropist?
37e48affff.a: Wolk's first pivotal moment came when he left Wall Street to start a restaurant delivery service and discovered greater satisfaction in helping struggling employees build skills. His second pivotal moment occurred 10 years into his career when research revealed only 4% of kids in Detroit read at grade level, sparking his focus on outcomes. The third pivotal moment came when he became a philanthropist and converted Finding Common Purpose into a grant-making foundation to fund communities focused on measurable outcomes.
